title: Mapping a finite machine's output
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $f$ map Boolean symbols to optional Boolean symbols. The mapped machine has the same number of work tapes and the same state set as $N$, and uses the transition rule obtained by mapping each transition's optional output through $f$ while leaving its other action data unchanged.
